changes.name: KT3b Cross-Regime Measurement Failure (EFC-VAL-2026-005)
changes.result: Null result + RCMP diagnosis. Four-run signal collapse (slope: -0.21 → +0.01 → -0.07 → 0.0) explained as a cross-regime measurement failure, not a physical null. KT3b violates the Regime-Consistent Measurement Principle in three ways: V1 driver-response mismatch (ρ_env L1 vs D_eff L2, underived α), V2 boundary observation (ℛ at a₀ on L1/L2 transition), V3 implicit regime mixing (Υ⋆ = 0.5 assumes L1 stellar physics). Three valid test architectures proposed: A (pure L2 RAR shape, 0 params, SPARC data available, recommended next step), B (pure L1 fσ8 growth, 1 param α_L1 = -0.14 ± 0.21), C (derived L1→L2 mapping, 0 params, open problem). DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.31963821

changes.name: Bullet Cluster Under EFC (EFC-VAL-2026-004)
changes.result: Four-axis confrontation with three JWST-era studies (Cha 2025, Rihtaršič 2026, Cho 2025). PIEMD A_sig 2D baseline = -6.9e-4, bootstrap p=0.98 (null operator validated). 10:1 minor-merger ratio tightens structural exclusion test (31173850). SIDM bound σ/m < 0.5 cm²/g consistent with EFC no-particle ontology. No new parameters; frozen at Ledger v3.11. Pre-registered A_sig on δκ residual remains pending as decisive discriminator. DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.31963668
